breakdown.description: Large pressure drops in gases cause significant density changes
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the constant density of 1.225 kg/m^3 despite the 10 bar to 1 bar pressure drop. The ground truth requires variable density calculated from the equation of state. The agent repeated the original error.

breakdown.description: Incompressible assumption is invalid for 10:1 pressure ratio
breakdown.reason: The generated specification uses the incompressible flow formula (Volume Flow Rate * Density with constant density), which is the incompressible assumption. The ground truth requires compressible treatment (integrating rho * u * dA with variable density). The agent did not flag or correct this invalid assumption.
